eventsDuringTransit.meaning: Love and value meet intensity. All-or-nothing attraction, deep desire, and a strong pull toward control in relationships. The trine makes this a natural strength: Depth and devotion in love, used deliberately. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

Connection and value meet disruption and freedom. Attraction runs electric, sudden, and unattached to convention. The trine makes this a natural strength: Exciting, unconventional bonds and an original aesthetic; freedom inside closeness. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

argumentSource.opening: After moving through {{priorSign}} from {{priorSignEntryDate}} to {{priorSignExitDate}}, Venus enters Libra on {{entryDate}}, and we pay closer attention to whether interest, effort, and consideration are being returned. Venus governs relationships, creativity, and what we value. Libra is the sign of balance, connection, and how we get along with each other. A shared decision includes both preferences. A purchase feels worth making because it is useful and beautiful. Affection becomes easier to trust when care does not have to be requested every time.
argumentSource.tension: The cost appears when agreement matters more than an honest answer. We ask what works for everyone else before admitting what works for us. We revise a preference until nobody can object, accept an arrangement because it looks even, and keep the peace after the effort stops being mutual. The decision then belongs to whoever was clearest, while the more accommodating side carries the extra cost. Resentment enters a relationship that still looks perfectly calm.
argumentSource.development: The issue may be a relationship where the same person always chooses the harmless answer, a shared expense left unequal because asking for the exact amount feels rude, or an attraction sustained by being admired rather than being known. Each compromise seems small. Together they teach others that our preferences can be moved and our limits can wait. By the time a real disagreement arrives, nobody knows which agreement was sincere.
argumentSource.close: Before {{exitDate}}, an arrangement may strain when the person who kept agreeing can no longer accept what they do not want.
